versions.changelog:
Initial release of Alibaba Cloud RDS Instances Manage skill.

- Enables querying and management of RDS instances, zones, classes, performance, logs, parameters, accounts, networks, whitelists, bills, and SQL statistics in the user’s Alibaba Cloud account.
- Supports explicit instance lifecycle operations: creation, parameter or spec changes, description, account creation, whitelist management, public endpoint allocation, whitelist template attachment, tagging, restart, and deletion.
- Requires readiness checks for CLI (≥ v3.3.3), plugins, credentials, and parameter correctness before any operation.
- Integrates CLI-based regional APIs with structured session observability and User-Agent tagging.
- Clearly separates read-only and mutating workflows; enforces strict confirmation and validation before any changes.
